parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description:
The streaming domain.

Separate multiple domain names with commas (,).

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end time. It must be later than the start time. The format is *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z (UTC).

> If you do not specify this parameter, data within one hour of the start time is queried by default.

parameters.name: IspNameEn
parameters.description:
The English name of the carrier.

For more information, see [DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp](~~91077~~).

parameters.name: LocationNameEn
parameters.description:
The English name of the region.

For more information, see [DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp](~~91077~~).

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time. The format is *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z (UTC).
